category_title: Five-year-old students exhibiting school-related frustration and challenging peer interactions
minimal_context: Patrick is in the classroom at dismissal time, transitioning to go home as his mother arrives.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Patrick, it is the end of the day. Please start packing up your things so we can transition to go home.

STUDENT: School is dumb.

TUTOR: We just need to get your materials ready.

STUDENT: I want to go home!

TUTOR: Your mother is arriving right now to pick you up.

STUDENT: (Kicks the furniture) I'm angry!

options.A: Provide Patrick with a verbal warning about the transition to go home as his mother arrives.
options.B: Walk across the classroom and stand directly behind Patrick while he is kicking the furniture.
options.C: Give Patrick a warning, followed by a 10-minute timeout if he does not stop kicking the furniture.
options.D: Show Patrick the screech owl photos and ask if he wants to take one home to draw and bring back tomorrow.
